invariants: every market row is derived from a V13-compatible snapshot shape
rolling change is derived only from qualified snapshot open and last-trade values
search and sort operate on presentation state without mutating canonical data
freshness is explicit and stale data remains visible rather than silently canonicalized
route health and settlement health are shown independently
watchlists are local browser preferences and create no protocol authority
demo fixtures are visibly labeled and never represented as canonical live market state
narrow viewports preserve market identity, last price and health visibility
